'''Terandi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] from the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Garth (city)|Garth]] in the [[North Country]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. He was the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Micae]]. [[Micae's mother|His wife]] [[Death/Legends|died]] in an invasion of Garth by the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] sometime during the [[Melida/Daan Civil War]]. Terandi fought and was killed in the [[Battle of the Plains]], a skirmish fought to avenge the previous century's [[Battle of the North]]. A [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of Micae left in a [[Hall of Evidence]] on [[Lake Weir]] mentioned Terandi, before Micae went on the describe his upcoming battle against the Melida.
